It also fires moderately (~0.35-0.55) on non-numeral words for a count of more than one, such as several, multiple, couple, dozen, dual, triple, both and few. It is silent (<0.1) on digits (2, 3), ordinals (second, third, first), ' one', 'some', 'another' and on the counted noun that follows.
